jobs.title: VP of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT FACTORY



Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).




ABOUT THE ROLE 

Factory is bringing autonomy to software engineering. We’re looking for a Product Marketer to define how Droids are understood, evaluated, and adopted by modern engineering organizations. You’ll shape the narratives, positioning, and market stories that drive enterprise demand and arm our sales team with the clarity they need to win.

This role sits at the intersection of product, marketing, and sales. You’ll translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, build the assets that accelerate deals, and shape how customers understand agent native development.




WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

 - Define our market position. Own company and product positioning, messaging, and category strategy across the engineering lifecycle.

 - Build the product marketing function. Establish the team, operating model, priorities, and measurement framework needed to support Factory’s growth.

 - Lead go-to-market strategy. Partner with Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, and BizOps to develop launch plans, audience strategies, and adoption programs.

 - Turn customer insight into strategy. Build a deep understanding of buyers, users, competitors, and market dynamics. Use those insights to influence product and go-to-market decisions.

 - Enable enterprise growth. Equip revenue teams with narratives, pitch decks, competitive intelligence, solution briefs, use cases, and proof points that move complex deals forward.

 - Tell stories that create demand. Translate sophisticated technical workflows into clear, outcome-driven narratives for engineering leaders, executives, and developers.

 - Lead product launches. Set the strategy and standards for launches, ensuring teams are aligned, sales is prepared, and customers understand the value of new capabilities.

 - Shape executive and market narratives. Partner with leadership on keynotes, customer conversations, analyst engagement, and other opportunities to establish Factory as a category leader.

 - Measure and improve impact. Define success metrics and use market feedback, customer research, product adoption, and revenue data to refine messaging and programs.

 - Champion the Factory voice. Ensure every customer-facing narrative reflects the clarity, ambition, and technical credibility behind our mission to bring autonomy to software engineering.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years of product marketing or related go-to-market experience, including leadership experience at a high-growth SaaS, AI, infrastructure, or developer-focused company.

 - A track record of building and leading high-performing product marketing teams.

 - Experience defining positioning and go-to-market strategy for technical products sold to enterprise customers.

 - Deep understanding of complex enterprise sales cycles and how to enable account executives and solutions engineers throughout the buyer journey.

 - Exceptional writing, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to make sophisticated technical concepts compelling to business and technical audiences.

 - Experience leading major product launches and coordinating cross-functional teams around a shared strategy.

 - Strong customer and market instincts, supported by a rigorous, data-informed approach to research and decision-making.

 - The ability to operate at both strategic and executional levels in a fast-moving environment.

 - Strong executive presence and the ability to influence Product, Sales, Marketing, and company leadership.

 - A passion for developers, AI, autonomy, and shaping how a new category is understood and adopted.

 

This is an in-office position (5 days/week) in San Francisco (walking distance to Caltrain)

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT FACTORY



Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).




ABOUT THE ROLE 



As a Product Manager at Factory, you will own the strategy and execution for a key area of our product suite, shaping how engineering teams experience autonomous software development. You will partner with customers to deeply understand their workflows, distill their feedback into actionable insights, and drive improvements that make Factory a fundamental driver of their daily work. You will collaborate with engineering, research, and go-to-market teams to ship features that push the boundaries of what AI can do for developers.

We are bringing autonomy to software engineering. The product surface area is vast and evolving rapidly. We need a product manager with sharp technical instincts, genuine empathy for developers, and the ability to make fast, high-quality decisions in ambiguity. You should be as comfortable diving into technical architecture discussions as you are presenting roadmap priorities to leadership.




WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

 - Own the roadmap for multiple major areas of our product

 - Partner closely with customers to understand pain points and translate them into product improvements.

 - Work with engineering and research to ship features that keep Factory at the frontier of AI-powered development.

 - Build frameworks and processes that scale as the product team grows.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of experience spanning product and engineering roles, including at least one year in an engineering role

 - Strong technical foundation, with experience partnering closely with engineering teams to design, build, and ship complex technical products.

 - Proven ability to drive product launches, from concept through release, with evidence of meaningful user adoption or commercial impact.

 - Background in developer tools or infrastructure products is a plus.

 - Actively engaged with the AI ecosystem, staying current on coding agents, model capabilities, and emerging industry trends through hands-on experimentation.Thrive in fast-moving, high-ambiguity environments and take ownership end-to-end.



The team works in the office 5 days a week in San Francisco (walking distance to Caltrain).

jobs.title: Product Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
ABOUT FACTORY



Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).




ABOUT THE ROLE


As the PM for Growth at Factory, you’ll own our overall approach to get users active and productive on the platform.

You’ll be responsible for our activation metric: how do we measure what it means to be an activated user, and how do we get more users to that point and beyond, whether they’re coming from our self-serve product or onboarding via an enterprise deployment.

And you’ll own our self-serve product offering: what we provide as part of it, how we price and package it, the role it plays in our broader company strategy, and how we should evaluate its success.

There won’t be a single “growth” engineering team to work with—you’ll operate across multiple engineering pods and work closely with our Marketing, BizOps, and Deployment functions to make sure we’re doing the right things to create more happy Factory users.

You’ll need a strong thesis for what makes a compelling early software factory experience in a competitive market, and an opinion about how PLG best reinforces a top-down Enterprise motion. You’ll need sharp technical instincts, genuine empathy for developers, and the ability to make fast, high-quality decisions in ambiguity. You should be as comfortable diving into technical architecture discussions as you are presenting roadmap priorities to leadership.

Our goal with the product function at Factory is to be high-leverage, high-ownership, and hands-on—you can expect to be working directly with the C-suite at the largest companies in the world, and shipping improvements directly to the product. And you’ll be central to defining the role of Product in a software factory-driven organization—a pattern we intend to pioneer and then help distribute across our customer base and the broader industry.




WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

 - Own the roadmap for multiple major areas of our product

 - Partner closely with customers and work closely with data to understand pain points and translate them into product improvements.

 - Work with engineering and research to ship features that keep Factory at the frontier of AI-powered development.

 - Build frameworks and processes that scale as the product team grows.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of experience spanning product and engineering roles, including a deep developer tools background or at least one year in an engineering role

 - Experience leading Growth teams in an Enterprise context, bringing a fast-paced and scientific mindset to product development.

 - Strong technical foundation, with experience partnering closely with engineering teams to design, build, and ship complex technical products.

 - Proven ability to drive product launches, from concept through release, with evidence of meaningful user adoption or commercial impact.

 - Actively engaged with the AI ecosystem, staying current on coding agents, model capabilities, and emerging industry trends through hands-on experimentation.Thrive in fast-moving, high-ambiguity environments and take ownership end-to-end.

The team works in the office 5 days a week in San Francisco (walking distance to Caltrain).

As the PM for Scale at Factory, you’ll own how our platform supports end-to-end software development at the largest companies in the world.

Every CIO/CTO is thinking about governing AI proliferation, controlling cost, and measuring token ROI. This role is about making the Factory platform the best way to do this when it comes to how AI is used for software engineering.

This is not a “tick the RBAC and audit logs boxes” role (though getting these features right is critical). It’s about empathizing with the challenge of managing AI coding tools within an enterprise, and building the capabilities and visibility that admins, executives, and end-users need to trust Factory and operate it efficiently. And it’s about building features that let Factory customers codify their organizational knowledge, rules, and best-practices in a way that lets them raise the bar for the software they build across their company.

You’ll own our Enterprise NDR metric, ensuring our customers are retaining and growing with Factory. You’ll work across a number of our different engineering pods to help prioritize the right features at the right time. You’ll work closely with our Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Deployment teams to make sure we’re incorporating feedback from the field, and pushing out new capabilities and techniques effectively. And you’ll work directly with customers to make sure we’re providing the right primitives to let them build and govern their ultimate software factory.

Our goal with the product function at Factory is to be high-leverage, high-ownership, and hands-on—you can expect to be working directly with the C-suite at the largest companies in the world, and shipping improvements directly to the product. And you’ll be central to defining the role of Product in a software factory-driven organization—a pattern we intend to pioneer and then help distribute across our customer base and the broader industry.

 - Own the roadmap for multiple major areas of our product

 - Partner closely with customers and work closely with data to understand pain points and translate them into product improvements.

 - Work with engineering and research to ship features that keep Factory at the frontier of AI-powered development.

 - Build frameworks and processes that scale as the product team grows.

 - 5+ years of experience spanning product and engineering roles, including a deep developer tools background or at least one year in an engineering role

 - Deep experience with what large-scale enterprise companies need to deploy developer tools across their organization.

 - Experience working closely with executive buyers at large organizations.
